in_sanskrit.name: माल्लय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Mallayya' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'माल्ल', which means 'flower'. The suffix 'य' (ya) is added to the root to make it a masculine name. Thus, the name 'Mallayya' means 'God of flowers'. It is a name that is often used to honor the deity Lord Murugan or Lord Krishna, both of whom are associated with flowers.
